en.headline: Police arrest woman after Diamond Hill knife report
en.dek: Officers detained a woman at Tsz Ching Estate after a Sunday evening report that she struck a station counter with a ceramic knife.
body: Police said they arrested a woman in the early hours of Monday after MTR staff at Diamond Hill station reported on Sunday evening that she had struck a customer-service counter with what officers believed was a ceramic knife, then left.

The force said the report was made at 6:50pm. After inquiries, officers suspected she was inside a flat at Ching Fai House in Tsz Ching Estate, Wong Tai Sin. Firefighters forced entry to the flat, and police arrested her and took her to Queen Elizabeth Hospital, RTHK reported, citing the police account.

Hong Kong 01, citing people at the scene, reported that the arrest was made at about 2am and that the woman was restrained on a stretcher before being taken to hospital. The outlet also reported that a ceramic knife about eight inches long was recovered at the station. Police have not announced a charge. A search of the Diamond Hill and Tsz Ching area on Sunday night had not located her.

zh.headline: 鑽石山持刀報案後 警方凌晨於慈正邨拘捕女子
zh.dek: 港鐵鑽石山站星期日傍晚報稱有女子持陶瓷刀敲打客務中心櫃枱後離開，警方其後在慈正邨正暉樓拘捕一名女子並送院。
body: 警方表示，星期日傍晚6時50分接獲港鐵鑽石山站職員報案，指一名女子手持相信是陶瓷刀的利器，敲打客務中心櫃枱後離開。警方調查後，於星期一凌晨拘捕涉案女子。
警方指，調查後懷疑女子身處黃大仙慈正邨正暉樓一個單位。消防破門入屋後，警員將她拘捕，並送往伊利沙伯醫院。港台引述警方說法作出報道。
《香港01》引述現場消息稱，拘捕時間約為凌晨2時，女子被固定在擔架床上送院。該報道又稱，警方在車站檢獲一把長約8吋的陶瓷刀。警方暫未公布控罪。星期日晚間警方曾在鑽石山及慈正邨一帶搜索，當時未有尋獲。
